title: Cohomology of a local integral perfect scalar model
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\pi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ and $S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $g:S\hookrightarrow X$ a locally closed immersion, that is, a closed immersion followed by an open immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-open-immersion]. On the small pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $B_T=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(R/\pi^n)_T$ for $T=X,S$, using constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. The projection maps give a canonical isomorphism $c_g:g^{-1}B_X\xrightarrow{\sim}B_S$, where inverse image is [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Define $g^*$ on module sheaves by inverse image followed by scalar extension along $c_g$. This functor is exact, as is restriction $j_U^*$ to the localized ringed site of any object $U$ of $S_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].

Use module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_X))$, and let $P^\bullet$ be a bounded complex of finitely generated projective $R$-modules, representing a perfect scalar complex [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Write $T_U(M)=j_U^*(B_S\otimes_{R_S}M_S)$ for scalar extension of the constant module sheaf with value an $R$-module $M$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Apply the exact restriction functors termwise on derived categories. If an isomorphism $j_U^*g^*K\simeq T_U(P^\bullet)$ is given, then, for every integer $q$, $H^q(P^\bullet)$ is finitely presented over $R$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] and that isomorphism induces an isomorphism
$$j_U^*g^*H^q(K)\simeq T_U(H^q(P^\bullet)).$$
No Noetherianity, dimension or residue-characteristic hypothesis on $X$ or $S$ is imposed. There is no assumption of derived completeness on $K$, nor a global constructibility conclusion.
